name: Flood Fill Voxelization
definition: GPU-based 3D flood fill algorithm to find all outer voxels not visible from outside along orthogonal directions, building upon incomplete voxelizations from primitive voxelization and orthogonal fill.
summary: Flood Fill Voxelization is a GPU algorithm that completes binary voxelization by propagating a frontier of outer voxels to resolve hidden surfaces and interior primitives that orthogonal methods miss.
